The weighted objective is
\[
F=100\sqrt{x^2+y^2}+200\sqrt{(x-200)^2+y^2}+300\sqrt{x^2+(y-300)^2}.
\]
Since \(300=100+200\),
\[
F=100\bigl(d(P,X)+d(P,Z)\bigr)+200\bigl(d(P,Y)+d(P,Z)\bigr).
\]
By triangle inequality,
\[
d(P,X)+d(P,Z)\ge d(X,Z)=300,
\]
\[
d(P,Y)+d(P,Z)\ge d(Y,Z)=\sqrt{200^2+300^2}=100\sqrt{13}.
\]
Thus
\[
F\ge 100\cdot 300+200\cdot 100\sqrt{13}=30000+20000\sqrt{13}.
\]
Equality occurs when \(P\) lies on both segments \(XZ\) and \(YZ\), so \(P=Z=(0,300)\). This is an integer grid point.

Therefore,
\[
x+y=0+300=300.
\]
\[
\boxed{300}
\]
